asOf: As of 10 September 2026. The ATP rankings are recalculated every Monday over a rolling 52 weeks.
footnote: Positions four to eight are deliberately blank. Two sources gave irreconcilable numbers for that part of the table — one was quoting the live ranking, which moves during a tournament and does not match Monday's official list — so we have left them out rather than publish a figure we cannot stand behind. Ninth and tenth are the tightest gap in the top twenty: five points between Shelton and Fritz.
